sources.title: Organising personal, financial and health records (National Institute on Aging)
Tennessee standards for assisted-care living facilities

binders.title: Parent Binder
binders.description: A place to gather contacts, medicines, insurance, legal papers, bills, dates and an emergency sheet when you start helping a parent.

blocks.text: Fill in this page together, with your parent's permission. Keep the binder somewhere private.
Copy the current list from your parent's clinician or pharmacy. Include nonprescription medicines and supplements. Ask them about any differences; do not change medicines using this sheet.
Print another copy of this page if you need more room.
Keep copies here or note where they are stored. Leave full policy numbers off shared copies.

Check what already exists and note where the current copy is kept. A checklist does not give anyone permission to act for another person. Ask a qualified professional about missing papers or questions.

items: HIPAA release / permission to share health information

blocks.text: This binder contains no legal forms and does not replace signed documents.
Note the bill, due date and where its records are kept. Do not write passwords, PINs or full account numbers here.
Use this page for appointments, renewals and reminders.
Keep this one page easy to find. Update it when contacts or health information change. In an emergency, call 911.

items: Parent / preferred name / date of birth
Current medicines / where to find the full list
Health information to share with responders
Advance directive / where a copy is kept

binders.title: Move-In Binder
binders.description: Paperwork, tour questions, a packing list, first-week reminders and address changes for a move into assisted living or a care home.

blocks.text: Ask the home for its own admission list and deadlines. Requirements depend on the home and the type of care; this is a place to track what it asks for.

items: Ask whether a TB test / screening record is needed and when
Get the home's physician report form and completion deadline
Gather the current medication list / required orders
Gather photo ID and insurance cards
Include Medicare, Medicaid / TennCare and supplemental cards if used
Locate relevant signed legal papers / health care permissions
Read the residency agreement and ask about unclear fees
Confirm which documents the home has received

sheets.title: Questions to ask on a tour

blocks.text: Bring the same questions to each home and write down the answers. Ask for written details where available.

items: What help is available during the day and overnight?
Who helps with medicines, and how are changes handled?
Which costs are included, and which are extra?
What happens if care needs or payment options change?
How does the home respond to an emergency?
What are the visiting, meal, transport and activity options?
How does the home handle concerns from families?
What are the move-out, refund and notice rules?

blocks.text: Ask for the home's room measurements, packing rules and list of items to leave at home. Use the name or room label the home requests.

items: Label clothes, shoes, glasses cases and personal items
Pack toiletries and everyday personal items
Bring glasses, hearing aids, mobility aids and their supplies
Arrange medicine delivery with the home / pharmacy
Choose familiar photos, bedding or small comfort items
Check furniture, cords and electrical items with the home
Record valuable items and agree where they will be kept

blocks.text: Make a short plan with your parent and the home. Write down who will answer questions.

items: Meet the main staff contact and ask how to reach them
Confirm the home received the current medicine list
Review meals, laundry, activities and visiting arrangements
Check that needed personal items arrived and are labelled
Agree how the family will receive updates
Ask your parent what feels comfortable and what needs attention
Write down concerns and who will follow up
Set a date to check in with your parent and the home

sheets.title: Who to notify of the address change

blocks.text: With your parent's permission, check each organisation's process. Confirm where important mail should go and who may request the change.
